projects.title: PracticeURWay: A Training Website for Resident Assistants
projects.overview: A training website that helps Resident Assistants review key policies, practice emergency decision-making, reflect on their responses, and access essential campus resources.
projects.audience: **Resident Assistants** supporting residents, responding to crises, and navigating campus protocols.
projects.challenge: RAs needed **quick access **to key policies, emergency steps, and practice opportunities to support **retention and decision-making**.
projects.solution: Built a **scenario-based training website** with policy review, branching practice, reflection prompts, and centralized resources.

process.needsAnalysis: Surveyed and interviewed learners; reviewed training data to identify knowledge gaps.
process.learningObjectives: Mapped training needs into scenario-based practice, policy review, and reflection activities.
process.designDevelopment: Built the website with interactive scenarios, feedback prompts, and centralized resources.
process.implementation: Analyzed feedback and revised content for clarity, engagement, and retention.

projects.title: Financial Service Representatives (FSR) Developmental Framework
projects.overview: A **developmental pathway** that transformed FSR learning needs into targeted recommendations and high-fidelity learning solutions.
projects.audience: **Financial Service Representatives**, Learning & Development Team, Human Resources Department
projects.challenge: FSRs lacked a **clear, structured development path**, making it difficult to address **performance gaps ** and build skills consistently across different stages of growth.
projects.solution: Designed a **role-aligned developmental framework** that translated identified learning needs into **targeted recommendations, structured learning stages, and practical eLearning solutions**.

process.needsAnalysis: Reviewed FSR development stages, learning needs, performance gaps, and existing resources.
process.learningObjectives: Mapped development stages to targeted learning strategies and support.
process.designDevelopment: Built the pathway, recommendations, and high-fidelity learning materials.
process.implementation: Refined recommendations and solutions based on stakeholder feedback.

projects.title: STEM Wellness Program Design
projects.overview: A student-centered wellness initiative translating mental health needs into accessible programs, community-led workshops, event proposals, and execution plans.
projects.audience: **Columbia Engineering students** seeking accessible wellness support, stress-management resources, and community-based programming.
projects.challenge: Students needed **engaging and approachable wellness experiences** that fit into a busy academic environment.
projects.solution: Designed and supported **wellness workshops, campaigns, newsletters, and events** to promote mental health, connection, and self-care across campus.

process.needsAnalysis: Assessed student wellness needs and communication gaps.
process.learningObjectives: Created student-centered workshop and campaign concepts.
process.designDevelopment: Developed newsletters, visual assets, and event materials.
process.implementation: Refined outreach and programming based on feedback.

projects.title: Digital Reading Pathway for ESL Learners
projects.overview: A structured learning pathway that makes English articles more accessible through guided, step-by-step reading experiences.
projects.audience: **ESL learners ** building vocabulary, comprehension, and reading confidence.
projects.challenge: Learners struggled with **complex articles, unfamiliar vocabulary, and limited reading confidence**.
projects.solution: Transformed traditional reading materials into **guided digital learning pathways** with curated articles, vocabulary support, comprehension tasks, and **interactive LMS activities**.

process.needsAnalysis: Identified ESL learners’ reading challenges and support needs.
process.learningObjectives: Curated articles and structured them into guided reading pathways.
process.designDevelopment: Built learner-facing LMS modules with reading activities and clear instructions.
process.implementation: Refined article selection, pathway structure, and activity instructions based on learner engagement.

projects.impact: Identified ESL learners’ reading challenges and support needs.

projects.title: Art-based Social-Emotional Learning Curriculum
projects.overview: A social-emotional coaching curriculum and highly artistic mentor-training handbook developed to support developmental conversations for high-risk youth.
projects.audience: **K–12 students** learning emotional awareness, self-expression, empathy, and peer relationship skills.
projects.challenge: SEL concepts can feel **abstract **when taught through traditional instruction alone.
projects.solution: Designed an **art-based SEL** course with drawing, reflection, and discussion activities.

process.needsAnalysis: Identified student SEL needs around emotional awareness, self-expression, empathy, and peer relationships.
process.learningObjectives: Created lesson themes, art prompts, reflection questions, and discussion activities.
process.designDevelopment: Facilitated interactive SEL lessons with mentors and supported student reflection.
process.implementation: Adjusted content and activities for different student populations.

philosophies.title: Learners First
philosophies.desc: Learning should be designed around the needs, motivations, and experiences of learners—not around content alone. I strive to create experiences that are relevant, accessible, and meaningful, helping learners build confidence as they progress.

philosophies.title: Learning Through Engagement
philosophies.desc: People learn best when they actively participate. I use interaction, storytelling, practice, and reflection to transform passive information into engaging learning experiences that encourage exploration and retention.

philosophies.title: From Knowledge to Action
philosophies.desc: Learning is most valuable when it leads to real-world application. I design experiences that help learners not only understand concepts, but also apply skills, solve problems, and perform effectively in authentic contexts.
